name: Three-role-supported parent curated causal targets
description: Compact Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct relationships bound shared-target indication-transfer joins to curated causal targets of drugs having three complementary target-label-excluded indication evidence roles.

semantics.definition: A compact relationship exists when a parent drug in the three-role non-target indication cohort has at least one exact biolink:affects edge to the gene, qualified by biolink:causes and sourced by ChEMBL, Guide to Pharmacology, or DrugCentral.

semantics.aggregation: Group qualifying exact causal affects edges by supported parent Drug and GeneOrGeneProduct endpoints and aggregate their edge identifiers, primary sources, and non-null direction qualifiers.
semantics.deduplication: Each raw relationship identity contributes once; source and direction strings are retained once per compact relationship even when repeated across edges.

name: Complete curated causal drug-target neighborhood
description: One compact relationship for each Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct pair supported by a causes-qualified member of the full affects descendant closure from ChEMBL, Guide to Pharmacology, or DrugCentral. The 8196 relationships span 1660 drugs and 1931 genes.

target.scope: All canonical Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct endpoint pairs in the fixed filtered graph with at least one qualifying curated causal effect.

semantics.definition: source_edge_count counts distinct raw relationships whose exact predicate is in the complete Biolink 4.3.2 affects closure, qualified_predicate is biolink:causes, and primary_knowledge_sources contains infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, or infores:drugcentral. The compact relationship also stores artifact_id, run_id, and round_id ownership strings.
inputs: Raw Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct edges under biolink:affects, affects_response_to, ameliorates_condition, decreases_response_to, disrupts, exacerbates_condition, has_adverse_event, has_side_effect, increases_response_to, or regulates
semantics.formula: source_edge_count = count(distinct qualifying raw relationship), grouped by canonical drug and gene endpoints; create a relationship exactly when count is positive.
semantics.aggregation: Filter exact predicates, causal qualification, and any allowed primary source before grouping by both endpoints. No treatment labels or evaluation results are used to choose the cohort.
semantics.deduplication: Each raw relationship identity counts once; repeated source identifiers on an edge do not multiply counts. One compact relationship is merged per canonical endpoint pair.
semantics.missing_value_policy: A missing causal qualifier or null or empty source array fails qualification. Pairs with no qualifying evidence have no compact relationship. Every stored count is positive.
semantics.interpretation: Presence is a reusable access path to curated causal pharmacology, not a new clinical evidence assertion. Rules must rematch raw edges with their own effective predicates, directions, aspects, and source constraints; this permits both exact-filtered and full-closure controls without silently changing either rule.

execution.create_cypher: MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:CAUSES|CONTRIBUTES_TO]->(disease:Disease) WHERE causal.predicate IN ["biolink:causes", "biolink:contributes_to"] WITH gene,collect(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases MATCH (regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[bridge:AFFECTS|AFFECTS_RESPONSE_TO|AMELIORATES_CONDITION|DECREASES_RESPONSE_TO|DISRUPTS|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT|HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|INCREASES_RESPONSE_TO|REGULATES]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE bridge.predicate IN ["biolink:affects", "biolink:affects_response_to", "biolink:ameliorates_condition", "biolink:decreases_response_to", "biolink:disrupts", "biolink:exacerbates_condition", "biolink:has_adverse_event", "biolink:has_side_effect", "biolink:increases_response_to", "biolink:regulates"] AND bridge.qualified_predicate='biolink:causes' AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ['increased','decreased'] AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ['activity','activity_or_abundance'] AND regulator<>gene WITH DISTINCT regulator,gene,diseases,bridge.object_direction_qualifier AS direction UNWIND diseases AS disease WITH regulator,disease,collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN direction='increased' THEN elementId(gene) END) AS increased_gene_element_ids,collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN direction='decreased' THEN elementId(gene) END) AS decreased_gene_element_ids CALL (regulator,disease,increased_gene_element_ids,decreased_gene_element_ids) { MERGE (regulator)-[context:MINER_R0004_SIGNED_CAUSAL_CONTEXT {artifact_id:'r0004-signed-regulator-causal-context-v1',run_id:'run-2026-08-21-0915'}]->(disease) SET context.round_id='round-0004',context.increased_gene_element_ids=increased_gene_element_ids,context.decreased_gene_element_ids=decreased_gene_element_ids,context.support_count=size(increased_gene_element_ids)+size(decreased_gene_element_ids) RETURN count(context) AS created_contexts } IN TRANSACTIONS OF 1000 ROWS RETURN sum(created_contexts) AS relationships
execution.verification_cypher: MATCH (regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[context:MINER_R0004_SIGNED_CAUSAL_CONTEXT]->(disease:Disease) WHERE context.artifact_id='r0004-signed-regulator-causal-context-v1' AND context.run_id='run-2026-08-21-0915' RETURN count(context) AS relationships,count(DISTINCT regulator) AS regulators,count(DISTINCT disease) AS diseases,count(context.support_count) AS values_populated,count(CASE WHEN context.support_count IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS values_missing,count(DISTINCT context.support_count) AS distinct_values,min(context.support_count) AS minimum,max(context.support_count) AS maximum,avg(context.support_count) AS mean,percentileCont(context.support_count,0.25) AS p25,percentileCont(context.support_count,0.5) AS p50,percentileCont(context.support_count,0.75) AS p75,percentileCont(context.support_count,0.9) AS p90,percentileCont(context.support_count,0.95) AS p95,sum(context.support_count) AS support_incidences,count(CASE WHEN context.increased_gene_element_ids IS NULL OR context.decreased_gene_element_ids IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_member_lists,count(CASE WHEN context.support_count<>size(context.increased_gene_element_ids)+size(context.decreased_gene_element_ids) THEN 1 END) AS inconsistent_counts

limitations: Regulatory signs and gene-disease causation do not establish the clinical risk direction or a corrective treatment mechanism.
The full affects closure includes ameliorates_condition; exact raw predicate rematching is mandatory for treatment-free rules.
Node element identifiers are local to this Neo4j instance and require rebuilding after graph reload or identity changes.
The cache is fixed to the current graph and has no automatic refresh policy.
name: Complete signed regulator-to-causal-disease contexts

semantics.aggregation: First deduplicate disease neighbors per downstream gene. Then deduplicate regulator and direction per downstream gene before expanding diseases. Group by regulator and disease and collect gene-node element identifiers separately for each sign. Store every nonempty context; the resource ceilings abort creation of the whole representation rather than truncate it. Write in transactions of one thousand context rows to bound transaction memory, without filtering or ranking any support. A partially completed write is not usable until verified as complete against the raw preflight.
semantics.deduplication: Parallel source edges do not multiply node-direction support. A gene with both signs contributes once to each list and twice to support_count. List order is immaterial.
semantics.definition: A regulator has a causes-qualified affects-descendant edge to a distinct downstream gene, with increased or decreased direction and activity or activity_or_abundance aspect; the downstream gene causes or contributes to the disease. support_count sums distinct downstream gene nodes separately by regulatory direction. increased_gene_element_ids and decreased_gene_element_ids store the corresponding unordered, deduplicated Neo4j node element identifiers. Ownership fields are artifact_id, run_id, and round_id.
semantics.formula: support_count = number of distinct increased downstream gene nodes + number of distinct decreased downstream gene nodes, grouped by regulator and disease.
inputs: Raw GeneOrGeneProduct-to-GeneOrGeneProduct effects under the complete Biolink 4.3.2 affects closure: ["biolink:affects", "biolink:affects_response_to", "biolink:ameliorates_condition", "biolink:decreases_response_to", "biolink:disrupts", "biolink:exacerbates_condition", "biolink:has_adverse_event", "biolink:has_side_effect", "biolink:increases_response_to", "biolink:regulates"]
Raw qualified_predicate, object_direction_qualifier, and object_aspect_qualifier values
Raw downstream-gene-to-Disease predicates under the complete contributes_to closure: ["biolink:causes", "biolink:contributes_to"]
Original endpoint-node identity; no external mapping or held-out label data
semantics.interpretation: This is a complete computational access path, not new evidence of treatment or a biological score. Dependent rules must rematch every original edge using their own exact expanded predicate sets, qualifiers, and sources. The broader stored affects closure cannot supply evidence that the rule excludes.
semantics.missing_value_policy: Missing or unsupported causal, direction, or aspect qualifiers do not qualify. An absent direction-specific neighborhood is an empty list. Pairs with no qualifying paths have no relationship. Node element identifiers are supplied by Neo4j for every source node.

target.scope: Every regulator-disease endpoint pair supported by the complete declared two-edge subpath in the fixed graph.
target.unit: distinct downstream gene-node and regulatory-direction incidences
